svg.title: ObjectDNA: evidence stays; design intent changes.
svg.desc: Actual 2392 retained synthetic bracket points and fitted CAD at 80.075 mm width; a 90 mm width edit retains the points and becomes a user-specified hypothesis. Exported STEP and generated CadQuery reopen as one valid solid.
svg.text: Geometric fit within the bracket grammar.
Point cloud unchanged. Acceptance is not inherited.
One valid solid; 90 mm X extent. Design intent is not a new scan measurement.
